messages:
miles: Quick brain-dump 1: preregistered network contracts idea for Private deploys. Want a compact rollout plan so field and legal know what to expect.

miles: Problem: customers want low-friction install + guarantees (egress stability, no-surprise upgrades). We can't promise full guarantees for every topology. Idea: offer 'preregistered contracts' that customers accept up-front: Relay, Pin, and Peer-Sovereign. Each contract includes manifest-signing, upgrade cadence, and rollback SLOs.

anya: Sounds good. Naming note: call them Relay / Pin-Window / Sovereign. Pin-Window should include a clear default (7d) and extension API. Also we should provide a small checklist card in Console that shows what the customer accepted.

jorge: Ops concerns: manifest-signing is non-negotiable for Sovereign. For Pin-Window we require either customer NAT pool or a leased pool with a lease-id in manifest. Also: preflight must list remediation steps (exact CLI commands or console links) instead of vague errors.

kelly: UX: Console must show pending manifest diff, the last applied manifest hash, and a one-click rollback that queues a revert job. Add audit entries for who triggered an upgrade or revert. Field will also want an exported preflight-report for airgapped installs.

ops-bot: Ticket created: PRD-9987 "Preregistered network contracts + manifest SLA" -> https://go/repo/PRD-9987 :spiral_note:

miles: Minimal example preset we can document quickly:
```
preset: relay
mode: outbound-proxy
egress_guarantee: none
preflight: [tls, dns-resolution, control-plane-reachability]
```

miles: For Pin-Window example:
```
preset: pin-window
mode: nat-pin
pin_days: 7
nat_pool_id: <customer-or-leased-id>
preflight: [route-propagation, nat-translation-check, dns]
postflight: [egress-ip-verify, handshake-sanity]
```

anya: Launch gates proposal:
- Gate 1: Relay GA (smoke tests + docs + 2 pilots)
- Gate 2: Pin-Window Beta (pin API, pin expiry UI, telemetry for ip_changes)
- Gate 3: Sovereign Field Release (manifest-signing + legal & security sign-off + runbook)

jorge: Acceptance criteria (high level): preflight pass/fail explanations, ability to revert within SLO, telemetry for egress_ip_change_count, and signed-manifest verification in CI.

kelly: Owners: preflight runner + reports -> jorge; pin API + lease logic -> anya; console UX (diff + revert) -> kelly; legal + terms -> miles.

miles: Action items:
- jorge: implement preflight schema + signed-report (owner)
- anya: design pin API + lease model (owner)
- kelly: mock console diff/revert flows (owner)
- miles: draft RFC + loop in contracts/security (owner)

miles: If no objections I'll lock this plan and add acceptance tests to PRD-9987 by tomorrow. React with :thumbsup: or add objections.

anya: :thumbsup:

jorge: :+1: starting preflight schema draft

kelly: :+1: will post mockups next week

ops-bot: PRD-9987 labels updated: +private-deploy +egress-sla +due 2026-06-30
